Premium comes from place, one hero per state, and almost nothing else on screen - not from violet/Inter alone. 75/25 budget named exactly: B1 sellout/house fills (/play + /board), B2 Two Peaks (/board), B3 class results frame (/board), B4 synthesis close (/board) at full cinema; H1 lock settle -> doors about to open and H2 N5-vs-N1 counterfactual at ~40%. /play state-by-state feelings; reference objects mapped: sidebar -> desk rail (club, night pips, two books docked, PIN demoted), goal card -> accountability card (two books, never Maximize Revenue), stat row -> tonight's printed facts, result screen -> box score with TURNOUT as hero, arena panel -> the building as a fill readout, dials -> two physical instruments of unequal size, bell -> a world event. /board: headline -> evidence -> footnote rail on every frame; the per-night class results table is missing today. /teach: calm command, Director Rail, elapsed clock only. Full memo: DIRECTION.md.
sections.experience-risks: 1 arena becomes decoration or a forecast (BC-4 by picture); 2 results screen becomes a dashboard (>2 figures >=34px); 3 wrong hero figure (price/money instead of turnout); 4 losing the no-preview honesty line; 5 premium-as-palette; 6 kids read less of what matters (lock control pushed below fold); 7 motion that reads as UI; 8 the two books collapse visually; 9 reveal mirror competes with the board; 10 cinema inflation across repeat sellouts; 11 reality sterilized by the grid (no logo-alikes, no Team N); 12 restyling drops numbers out of the claim audit.
sections.non-negotiables: Nothing derived from the pending action pre-lock incl. pictures; bowl renders settled turnout only; CASH/RENEWALS never share slot/unit/accent, never summed; heightened treatment confined to B1-B4/H1-H2; every board frame headline->evidence->footnote, caveat never heavier than the claim; semantic state never colour-only; LOCK IT IN reachable without scrolling at 1366x768 and 1024x600, PIN leaves the hero slot; no D4 chrome; every motion has a reduced-motion collapse, no spring on money; Module 1 rendered output unchanged (module-scoped tokens); real club wordmarks, no Team N; no fictional nav; every figure stays a registered ClaimAtom; the bell keeps manual fallback and onPhaseExit force-close.
sections.open-questions: Q1 gold in M2 (recommend retire as UI accent, keep as floodlight warmth); Q2 is the per-night CLASS RESULTS table in scope (new frame work); Q3 reveal-mirror subordination vs sightline access; Q4 class table page vs compress at 12-15 desks; Q5 ceiling on repeat sellouts; Q6 wave scope for /play mirrors; Q7 generic bowl, no identifiable architecture. Boss lead rulings recorded at the end of DIRECTION.md: Q1 (a); Q2 in scope for wave 3 subject to econ/classroom rulings; Q3 accepted with access preserved; Q4 page past 8 desks; Q5 first sellout full, later abbreviated; Q6 wave 2 = /play all states restyled, wave 3 = board/teach/synthesis; Q7 confirmed.

kid-b-casual-baseline-dissent.finding: For the casual/low-reading grade 5-6 student pairs-on-one-device persona, the current M2L1 Full House build should not ship to a real classroom as-is. Every per-night result card renders below the fold behind the next night's full pricing UI on a 1366x768 student viewport (confirmed at two consecutive night transitions), inverting the founder's own preserved reference decision that the consequence gets a separate, larger screen state than the decision. A fast, low-reading student can play all five nights end to end -- dial, LOCK IT IN, dial, LOCK IT IN -- without ever reading a single one of her own result cards, leaving the experience->consequence->adaptation loop that is this lesson's core promise dependent entirely on a compact header number and, later, the class board -- not on anything her own device reliably shows her at the moment it matters.

baseline-browser-qa-dissent.finding: /teach at 1366x768 (the design-target teacher viewport) has no sticky/fixed anchor for its session-pacing controls (PHASE chips, Advance, Open the doors, Release the Two Peaks, End session) and no scroll-management on phase change, so those controls are inconsistently below the fold depending on how much director-note text renders for a given beat -- confirmed by DOM measurement and by grep (no position:sticky/fixed rule for this panel in theme.css; no scrollIntoView/scrollTo call in teach/main.ts). This is not a hard trap, but it is real live-pacing friction on the surface CLAUDE.md names as where 'teacher paces phases' -- a teacher mid-class should not have to hunt for the button that advances the room.

kid-a-basketball-baseline-dissent.finding: M2L1 Full House should not ship to a real grades 5-6 class as-is for the sports-fluent student. At the classroom's own 1366x768 viewport the night result renders at top=758px and the box score at top=813px with scrollY=0 and no auto-scroll, so the consequence of the pair's own decision is offscreen after every bell; the lesson's title event, the sellout, is cut off by the bottom of the screen; at 1024x600 the LOCK IT IN control itself is below the fold. Across the seven-stage teacher-paced reveal the student device is byte-identical in all eight captured frames (md5 05aa7a5185a8c10e1dcbde46ce5b736f) and already displays THE TWO PEAKS at stage 0, while the board still reads 'waiting for your teacher' - the lesson's punchline reaches every desk six stages before the room. Renewals fall 50% to 0% with no alarm state and no per-night explanation, and the printed renewals rule mispredicts the student's own largest result. The economics underneath is alive and worth keeping; the surface, staging and pacing currently prevent a real classroom from experiencing it. SIMULATED KID / AGENT-PLAYTESTED - not human-tested.

econ-adaptation-rulings-dissent.finding: Four reference elements must never ship in any form, and one structural gap must be closed before the rebuild starts. (1) Pre-lock 'Projected Attendance / Projected Revenue / Projected Profit' and the demand-at-a-glance curve with the live price plotted on it: BC-4 and fullHouse.ts:9-15 forbid any revenue preview and anything derived from the pending action in the pre-lock view; a moving projection also converts the price dial from reasoning into a sweep, voiding the STRONG-rated blind-commit loop. (2) 'Target: $110-$120': reveals a purported optimum and is wrong in this model -- OBSERVED cash-best is $24-$48 on four of five nights and $84-$90 on Night 4, while $110-$120 returns turnout 0 and a full-bill loss (-$520,000 NY / -$280,000 MEM) on N1, N2, N3 and N5. (3) The trophy plus 'Strong Round! You're building momentum. Keep optimizing to maximize profits.': reward chrome under D4, an evaluative claim the model cannot make (no single objective), and a direct overruling of the module's own teacher script, which instructs 'DO NOT evaluate them -- no good, no that's high. You are collecting, not marking.' (4) The projector CLASS RESULTS per-desk TOTAL REVENUE and TOTAL PROFIT columns and the prompt 'Why didn't the highest price always win?': CurvePoint carries no money at all, so those columns require adding per-desk money to boardView -- precisely the money leaderboard fullHouse.test.ts:813 (D4/R13) exists to prevent -- and the prompt presupposes a class result the model refutes: OBSERVED over 4,000 simulated 6-desk classes per cell, the highest-priced desk also has the highest cash on Night 4 in 98.7% (timid pricing) and 100.0% (mid pricing) of classes, so the frame would be refuted by the table printed above it. STRUCTURAL GAP: Full House registers no ClaimAtom and no test in this repository reads a line of runtime/src/client/**; all four of the above can be built in the client with npm test staying 461/461 green and the L1 harness still reporting ALL 16 PROPERTIES HOLD. R-1 (a rendered-claim limb on the client, with a mutation limb proving it bites) must land before or with the first rebuilt surface, or this wave ships its economics unaudited. ADDED after adjudicating two kid-baseline findings: (5) the rebuilt /play REVEAL surface must not render Two Peaks before the board releases it -- studentView REVEAL has no revealStage gate (fullHouse.ts:2246-2249) while boardView gates at press 6 of 7 (2522-2523), so every desk currently holds the centrepiece answer six presses early; and (6) no renewals visual may encode a monotone price-up-renewals-down relationship -- OBSERVED renewalDelta is +9 (New York) and +10 (Memphis) at $90 on Night 4 and keeps gaining to $114 / $104, so the intuitive gauge would be false on the night the room remembers most.
